table_routing_rule: experiment -> expsample.result_schema -> lk_expsample_result_schema.table_name (do not route on experiment.measurement_technique)

claim_1.claim: CyTOF analysis of PBMCs from 52 COVID-19 patients and 62 healthy controls showed increased frequencies of plasmablasts and effector CD8 T cells in infected individuals compared to healthy controls.

comparison.finding: increased frequencies of plasmablasts and effector CD8 T cells in infected individuals compared to healthy controls

immport.notes: Healthy count matches the paper's 62; ImmPort has 71 COVID-19 subjects vs the paper's 52, so the sample/time-point choice matters.

reproduction_plan: Resolve groups from immune_exposure.disease_stage_reported (SDY1669 arms are cohorts, not disease); drop Post and Other subjects.
Keep the earliest sample per subject (min study_time_collected); report all-samples as a sensitivity check.

SELECT subject_accession, expsample_accession, study_time_collected, population_name_reported, population_statistic_reported FROM fcs_analyzed_result WHERE study_accession='SDY1669' AND experiment_accession='EXP30963' AND population_name_reported IN ('plasmablast','Effector_CD8').
Join to groups on subject_accession.
Two-sided Mann-Whitney U per population (2 tests), BH-FDR; report median per group and direction.
Reproduced if both populations are higher in COVID-19 with FDR < 0.05.

claim_2.claim: Flow Cytometry analysis of PBMCs from COVID-19 patients showed reduced production of IFN-α and TNF-α in plasmacytoid dendritic cells in response to TLR stimulation compared to healthy controls.

comparison.finding: reduced production of IFN-α and TNF-α in plasmacytoid dendritic cells in response to TLR stimulation in COVID-19 patients compared to healthy controls

immport.experiment_name: Flow cytometry of ex vivo stimulated PBMCs

condition_filter.note: Stimulation is recorded only in expsample.description; expsample_2_treatment rows are placeholders (EST-stim_flow_treatment).

immport.notes: 3 expsamples per subject (one per stimulation condition).

reproduction_plan: Resolve groups from immune_exposure.disease_stage_reported (SDY1669 arms are cohorts, not disease); drop Post and Other subjects.
Keep the earliest sample per subject (min study_time_collected); report all-samples as a sensitivity check.

SELECT f.subject_accession, f.expsample_accession, es.description AS stimulation, f.study_time_collected, f.population_name_reported, f.population_statistic_reported FROM fcs_analyzed_result f JOIN expsample es USING(expsample_accession) WHERE f.study_accession='SDY1669' AND f.experiment_accession='EXP30964' AND f.population_name_reported IN ('pdc_IFN','pdc_TNF','pdc_IFN_TNF').
Keep Viral and Bacterial (TLR stimuli); optionally subtract the same subject's No_stimulation value.
Two-sided Mann-Whitney U per readout x stimulus, BH-FDR; report median per group and direction.
Reproduced if pdc_IFN and pdc_TNF are lower in COVID-19 with FDR < 0.05.

claim_3.claim: Olink analysis of plasma from COVID-19 patients showed significant up-regulation of 43 cytokines, including IL-6, MCP-3, and CXCL10, compared to healthy controls.

comparison.finding: significant up-regulation of 43 cytokines, including IL-6, MCP-3, and CXCL10

immport.readout_values: all 74 analytes; named in claim: IL6, MCP.3, CXCL10
immport.notes: experiment.measurement_technique is 'Other'; route via result_schema. NPX is log2-scale, so a difference in medians is a log2 fold change.

reproduction_plan: Resolve groups from immune_exposure.disease_stage_reported (SDY1669 arms are cohorts, not disease); drop Post and Other subjects.
Keep the earliest sample per subject (min study_time_collected); report all-samples as a sensitivity check.

SELECT subject_accession, source_accession AS expsample_accession, study_time_collected, analyte_reported, concentration_value_reported FROM mbaa_result WHERE study_accession='SDY1669' AND experiment_accession='EXP30965'.
Two-sided Mann-Whitney U for each of the 74 analytes, BH-FDR.
Count analytes significantly up in COVID-19 (paper: 43) and confirm IL6, MCP.3, CXCL10 are among them.
